neighbours.label: the country names China, Canada, India, Brazil in the middle of a sentence, as a modifier or not
fire: She keeps a copy of the report from China on her desk.
We read a long article about Brazil in class.
A flock of Canada Geese flew over the farm.
He drew the plans in India ink.
Exports from Canada rose sharply last year.
The scholars published The China Study in 2005.
Many families in India own a small plot.
Her cousin moved from Brazil to Lisbon.
quiet: She keeps a copy of the report from Paris on her desk.
We read a long article about Rome in class.
A flock of wild geese flew over the farm.
He drew the plans in black ink.
Exports from Ohio rose sharply last year.
The scholars published The Oxford Study in 2005.
Many families in Lyon own a small plot.
Her cousin moved from Boston to Lisbon.

notes: Second round of my sweep 10 label ('as a modifier'), which failed because 'the report from China' reached 0.51 and 'about Brazil' 0.38. 'traveled to China' was at 0.21 and 'people of India' 0.12 in the probes, so this may also vary by frame.
